## Why it matters

The Österreichische Mediathek preserves Austrian audio and video recordings and provides a digital collection, catalogue, online exhibitions, and classroom materials.

It is particularly valuable for research that depends on sound and moving image sources, oral history, or media history rather than text-only documentation.
